items.title: Show HN: AgentTrace–Observability and runtime self-healing engine for AI agents
items.summary: AgentTrace 是一个面向 AI Agent 流水线的可观测性与运行时自愈引擎：基于 Python/Pydantic 的装饰器 SDK 在工具调用前校验 Schema，搭配 FastAPI+SQLite 后端收集 trace。当 LLM 在多步运行中幻觉出错误参数（如字符串代替浮点、虚构字段名、缺失必填项）时，AgentTrace 通过 Groq 快速推理自动修复负载，避免工作流崩溃。配套 Next.js+Tailwind 实时仪表盘含 Payload Diff Inspector，目前可提供在线 Demo（Vercel 仪表盘 + Render API Swagger 文档）。
items.summary_en: AgentTrace is an open-source observability and self-healing engine for autonomous AI agent pipelines that automatically repairs malformed LLM tool arguments at runtime—such as string-to-float mismatches, invented key names, and missing schema fields—preventing workflow crashes. Built with a Python/Pydantic decorator SDK, a Groq-powered self-healing layer, and a FastAPI+SQLite backend with a Next.js dashboard featuring a Payload Diff Inspector.

items.title: llm-keys-ui 0.1
items.summary: llm-keys-ui 0.1 是一个解决 LLM API 密钥安全配置的插件，专为 Codex Remote 远程代码代理场景设计，允许用户通过手机界面而非直接粘贴方式向远程机器传输密钥。其核心使用流程为：在 Codex 中执行 `uvx --with llm-keys-ui llm keys-ui --all` 获取包含局域网或 Tailscale 地址的密钥配置界面 URL，之后通过 `llm keys get <provider>` 命令安全调用密钥。该方案避免了将敏感密钥直接粘贴进聊天会话的风险，简化了多设备环境下的 API 密钥管理操作。
items.summary_en: llm-keys-ui 0.1 is a plugin that lets users store and retrieve API keys on remote machines via a web interface, eliminating the need to paste keys directly into agent sessions. Triggered by running `uvx --with llm-keys-ui llm keys-ui --all`, it provides a URL accessible over local network or Tailscale, where keys can be saved and later retrieved using commands like `llm keys get anthropic`. Designed for use with Codex Remote coding agents.

items.title: I Built a 100% Free AI Toolbox with No Sign-Up (Here's How)
items.summary: 作者开发了开源AI工具箱MagicKit，集成AI图片生成（基于FLUX模型）、AI写作和AI视频制作三个功能，全程无需注册、无需API Key，依托Pollinations免费API构建。项目采用Node.js + Express后端与纯HTML/CSS/JS前端，部署在仅1.6GB内存的VPS上，通过串行队列和指数退避重试机制解决免费API的速率限制问题，并使用FFmpeg concat demuxer替代复杂滤镜以确保视频稳定输出。代码开源在GitHub（MIT协议），一键部署即可运行。
items.summary_en: MagicKit is an open-source, free AI toolbox offering image generation (FLUX model via Pollinations API), AI writing, and video creation with no sign-up or API key required. Built on Node.js/Express with pure HTML/CSS/JS frontend, it runs on extremely constrained hardware (~60 MB RAM on a 1.6 GB VPS) by using serial request queuing with 3-second minimum intervals and exponential backoff, replacing Node's https module with curl for reliability, and using FFmpeg's concat demuxer with simple scaling/padding filters instead of complex transition chains. The project is MIT-licensed on GitHub, with plans for pluggable image backends and optional self-supplied API keys.

items.title: asciimoo/hister
items.summary: Hister 是一个开源的本地个人搜索引擎，通过 Chrome 或 Firefox 扩展自动索引用户访问过的网页和存储的文件，支持命令行、Web 界面和 MCP AI 助手三种访问方式，具备全文检索与可选的语义搜索功能。部署时只需下载二进制文件运行 `./hister listen`，安装浏览器扩展后即可实现本地全自动网页归档与检索，默认无遥测和云同步。
items.summary_en: Hister is a privacy-focused personal search engine that indexes the full contents of web pages you visit and files you keep, enabling search from a browser (via Firefox/Chrome extension), terminal, or AI assistant through MCP. It runs locally on port 4433 with no telemetry or cloud sync, supports full-text and optional semantic search, and is built in Go 1.26 under AGPLv3.

items.title: yynxxxxx/Codex-X
items.summary: Codex-X 是一款面向 OpenAI Codex 桌面端与 CLI 的跨平台可视化管理工具，支持提示词注入管理（内置 5 套模板，可导入 .md 自定义）、第三方 Provider/API 切换与连接检测、会话同步与精确删除、Skills/MCP 管理以及 config.toml 与 Token 用量可视化。提供 macOS Apple Silicon / Intel、Windows MSI / 便携版和 Linux 安装包。
items.summary_en: Codex-X is a cross-platform desktop tool (macOS, Windows, Linux) that provides visual management for OpenAI Codex desktop and CLI, consolidating prompt templates, provider/API switching, session sync, Skills/MCP management, and TOML configuration into one interface. It includes 5 built-in prompt templates with 7 additional ones available via GitHub sync, supports multiple named official and third-party API providers with connection testing and one-click switching, and offers session organization by project path, deletion, and token usage statistics by date and model.

items.title: Show HN: Lain, a structural code graph and agent coordinator for coding agents
items.summary: LAIN 是一款基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的代码智能与多代理协调引擎，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 编码代理设计，可将代码库索引为内存级属性图。它利用 Tree-sitter AST 解析、语言服务器及 Git 提交历史构建代码结构，提供瞬时查询、热重载和交互式工具控制台等功能，并通过 get_blast_radius、get_call_chain、trace_dependency 等确定性 MCP 工具辅助代理精准导航、分析影响范围与依赖关系，避免幻觉编辑。

items.title: Show HN: Openmsg, agent-to-agent talk while they run, Claude<>Codex<>OpenCode
items.summary: Openmsg是一个可在本地或跨机器实现不同厂商AI编码agent（Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode）实时互发消息的开源工具，v0.2版本已发布在npm上，支持端到端加密与所有者身份验证。其核心命令包括`openmsg list`、`openmsg send <agent> "<text>"`和`openmsg inbox`，消息采用A2A标准信封格式并内置签名、指纹比对和78个无账户依赖的测试用例。运行仅需Node 22及以上版本，零外部依赖。

items.title: ruanyf/weekly
items.summary: `ruanyf/weekly` 是阮一峰创办的科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布，记录值得分享的科技内容。该仓库已累积至第413期（2026年9月），涵盖AI、编程、开源软件、创业等话题，并设有免费程序员招聘帖"谁在招人"讨论区，欢迎社区投稿文章、软件和资源。
items.summary_en: **ruanyf/weekly** (Tech Enthusiasts Weekly) is a Friday-published Chinese-language tech curation newsletter by ruanyf, featuring curated articles, software, and resources spanning AI, programming, open-source, and industry trends. Issues are numbered sequentially from #260 (June 2023) to #413 (September 2026), with a community hiring forum titled《谁在招人》providing free programmer job listings. Recent issues cover topics including the decline of React Native, AI caching/memory mechanisms, and the职业未来 of programmers amid AI adoption. Submissions are accepted via GitHub issues.

items.title: 阶跃星辰发布旗舰模型 Step 5 Preview，10 月 15 日开源权重
items.summary: 阶跃星辰发布旗舰基座模型 Step 5 Preview，采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数量 600B、激活 27B，支持 100 万 Token 上下文和文本视觉多模态输入。该模型在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 获得 44 分，位居全球开源模型前三，单任务成本仅为 Claude Opus 5 的 1/8。权重将于 10 月 15 日开源开放。
items.why_now_en: Step 5 weights drop Oct 15, undercutting Opus
items.summary_en: StepFun released its flagship base model Step 5 Preview, a sparse MoE architecture with 600B total and 27B activated parameters, supporting 1M-token context and multimodal text-vision input. It scored 44 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking among the top three global open-source models, at one-eighth the per-task cost of Claude Opus 5. Weights will be open-sourced on October 15.

items.title: 派早报：微软高管称 AI 爬取是人类历史上最大的劳动成果盗窃
items.summary: 《纽约时报》等媒体起诉微软与OpenAI版权侵权案披露的内部文件显示，ChatGPT和Copilot上线后部分原告媒体点击率骤降51%至94%，OpenAI曾对绕过付费墙的技术回复"不错"，且涉及180万篇报道的第三方数据集。此外，谷歌Android 17 QPR1成为Android 3.x以来首个引入Pixel独占API未同步AOSP的系统版本
items.summary_en: Court documents from *The New York Times*'s copyright lawsuit against Microsoft and OpenAI reveal that Microsoft AI science director Brent Hecht internally warned that large-scale AI scraping of news content was "the greatest theft of human labor in history," while OpenAI president Greg Brockman approved workarounds for the *Times*' paywall. Internal data also showed AI platforms caused plaintiff media click-through rates on search channels to plummet by 51%–94%, and OpenAI reportedly misused a third-party dataset containing 1.8 million articles despite knowing it violated a non-commercial agreement.

items.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
items.summary_en: World model companies like Yann LeCun's AMI Labs and Fei-Fei Li's World Labs have accumulated significant funding and buzz but remain highly secretive about their commercialization plans and specific product directions. World Labs' Marble is the most developed offering, with demos spanning media creation, explorable game environments, and CGI, while AMI has explored applications in manufacturing, biomedicine, and robotics through its Nabia partnership. The strategic silence stems from a "dark forest" dynamic: revealing a clear path to market would attract competitors including other world model labs, neolabs, OpenAI, and Anthropic, so companies delay disclosures as long as possible.
